definitions.explanation: The scientific study of the earth's physical structure, rocks, minerals, and the processes that shape the land over time.

examples.japanese: {地質学|ちしつがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to major in geology and study volcanoes.

examples.japanese: {地質学|ちしつがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{活断層|かつだんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: A geological survey revealed that there is an active fault in this area.

examples.english: In earthquake-prone Japan, geological knowledge is also applied to architecture and urban planning.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{地質|ちしつ}→地質：04055_chishitsu⟧ (geological composition) and ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study, discipline). Particularly relevant in Japan, which sits on the junction of four tectonic plates and has numerous active volcanoes and frequent earthquakes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地質学|ちしつがく}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: geologist
- {地質学|ちしつがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧: geology professor
- {地質学|ちしつがく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: geological survey
- ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧{地質学|ちしつがく}: applied geology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地学|ちがく}→地学：07106_chigaku⟧: earth science — a broader field that includes geology, meteorology, and oceanography
- {鉱物学|こうぶつがく}: mineralogy — the study of minerals specifically
- ⟦{地理学|ちりがく}→地理学：25641_chirigaku⟧: geography — studies spatial relationships between people and environments, overlaps with geology in physical geography
